items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did "Haunting Melody" with Sarah Vaughn... I was playing drums on that.

ctx.x: All these were hit records. I did Fabian's first hit record, "Like a Tiger." And I did "These Things Remind Me of You" with Della Reese; I did "Haunting Melody" with Sarah Vaughn, which is the only million selling record she ever made; I did, "What's the Matter, Baby," with [Timmie Yuro.]
Yeah, from California. I think I was on that, too.
